description: Work with Git repositories and GitHub through the installed git and gh CLIs. Managed operation: use op:start with kind:check to inspect setup, or kind:git/kind:gh plus argv for one non-interactive command. The result includes bounded output and direct setup instructions when a dependency, Git identity, or GitHub authentication is missing.

op.description: Operation lifecycle. Use start for a setup check or command. Poll exists only for managed-operation compatibility because commands finish synchronously.

kind.description: Required with op:start. check reports whether git, gh, Git identity, and GitHub authentication are ready. git or gh executes exactly one command from argv.

repo.description: Workspace-relative existing directory in which to run the check or command, such as "." or "repos/project". Defaults to the workspace root. Never use an absolute path or .. traversal.

argv.description: Required and non-empty for kind:git or kind:gh. Each item is one literal CLI argument, starting with the subcommand, for example ["status","--short"] or ["pr","list","--limit","20"]. No shell syntax is evaluated. Supply all flags needed for non-interactive use. Never put credentials here; configure gh authentication outside the action.

handle.description: Opaque handle returned by start; only used with op:poll.
